name: Oracle
about: No lab-tested knowledge yet: DBaba recognises Oracle from its syntax or error format and answers with general SQL reasoning plus the notes below. These are notes from the official docs, not lab-proven rules.
weak_why: NVL, DUAL and DECODE also work on MariaDB (and DUAL on MySQL), so alone they don't show Oracle.

notes.limit: Oracle has no LIMIT: use FETCH FIRST n ROWS ONLY (12c and later; OFFSET m ROWS before it), or ROWNUM in an outer query (ROWNUM is numbered before ORDER BY, so sort in a subquery first).
notes.concat: || joins text on Oracle; an empty string is NULL on Oracle, so || skips it and '' IS NULL is true.
notes.null_fn: NVL(x, 0) is Oracle's null replacement; COALESCE works too and is portable.
notes.full_join: FULL OUTER JOIN is supported; the old (+) outer-join marker is still accepted but the JOIN syntax is clearer.
notes.now: SYSDATE (no brackets) is the date and time; TRUNC(SYSDATE) today's date; CURRENT_DATE / SYSTIMESTAMP also exist.
notes.date_add: d + 7 adds days to a DATE; ADD_MONTHS(d, 1) adds months; INTERVAL '7' DAY works too.
notes.date_diff: date - date gives days (with a fraction when there is time); MONTHS_BETWEEN(a, b) months.
notes.string_agg: LISTAGG(col, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) joins a group's text.
notes.identity: GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY (12c+) or a sequence: seq.NEXTVAL; RETURNING id INTO a variable gives the new id.
notes.upsert: MERGE INTO t USING ... ON (...) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...
notes.dual: SELECT without a table needs FROM DUAL (until 23ai).
notes.case: Text comparison is case-sensitive by default; UPPER() both sides or NLS_COMP=LINGUISTIC to ignore case.
notes.quotes: Names in "double quotes" keep their case; unquoted names are stored in UPPER case.
notes.length: LENGTH counts characters, LENGTHB bytes; LENGTH('') is NULL (empty text is NULL).
notes.if: No IF() in SQL: CASE WHEN ... END or DECODE(x, a, b, c).
notes.boolean: No BOOLEAN column type before 23ai: NUMBER(1) or CHAR(1) with a check.
